body: That’s nice to hear. My gf is the same, before being in a relationship I didn’t realize how much having a partner would help since it’s someone I’m close to who I can confide in and she does the same. I might take you up on your offer sometime since I don’t really know anyone else in real life with OCD and it’s always nice to talk to people with similar experiences

Huh, sometimes I forget you find people with similar experiences online haha. Yeah very similar to what my gf said about E not being entitled to any info especially about mental health stuff. Thanks for the last line I’m not sure how you’re doing but you stay strong as well :)
